text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Bull's-eye! I knew ya could do it,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My little sisters are gonna love this!<n>Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining their happy faces is<n>enough to get
me smilin' too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a million! This is shapin' up to<n>be a great
day!
